history.summary: A freehold 667 sqft 1BR near Haw Par Villa MRT asking $1,679 psf — modestly below the project's 12-month average of $1,714 psf — with a long-horizon Greater Southern Waterfront angle. But this is a tiny 52-unit development with extremely thin liquidity (only ~8 sales in 3 years), negative trailing CAGR on 12 txns and a 4-txn cohort, so both the data signals and the resale exit are fragile.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,679.16 psf is only slightly under the verified 12-mo avg of $1,714 psf (range $1,618-$1,848), so the discount is marginal rather than decisive. The dossier's age_adj_premium of -9.3% and the -1.97% CAGR both rest on thin data (appreciation_txns=12, psf_cohort_txns=4) — per v3.4 priors that warrants skepticism and lower confidence. Freehold is not a forward edge on its own. The redeeming features are a real MRT (Haw Par Villa CC25, Circle Line) and the structural Greater Southern Waterfront redevelopment thesis, but that catalyst is long-dated and uncertain. With a 52-unit project and ~8 sales in 3 years, exit liquidity is poor for a 5-7yr investment hold. Net: a fairly-priced, illiquid hold — Neutral.
red_flags: Very thin liquidity — 52-unit project, only ~8 sales in 3 years; difficult resale exit
Negative trailing 5yr CAGR (-1.97%) on just 12 txns and a 4-txn psf cohort — fragile data
Discount to project avg is marginal (~2%), not a decisive value edge
High $1.12M quantum for a 1BR narrows the buyer pool
catalysts: Haw Par Villa CC25 / Pasir Panjang CC26 (Circle Line) walkable
Greater Southern Waterfront long-term redevelopment upside (long-dated, uncertain)
Freehold tenure and rooftop-pool boutique product
Rental yield ~3.6%, above the D5 norm
